text:
sahil: HelixHealth (Dedicated enterprise) filing urgent SLA impact. Since 2026-03-19 ~02:30 UTC their p95 token latency jumped from ~200ms to ~800ms after a deploy. Support ticket link: https://redwood.internal/s/TICKET-1423 (redacted). Can product + eng help triage and scope mitigation?

maria: looping product in. What SLA tier and any repro data?

tess (Support): Enterprise S1. No customer-side changes reported. We deployed redwood-13b-v1-quant into their dedicated pool at ~02:30 UTC. Logs attached to the ticket. Customer says checkout flows are timing out.

kai: my initial hunch is quantization perf regression or fallback to slower kernels. Need per-token trace, kernel selection traces, KV cache hit rates, and batch size distribution.

aj: pulling infra metrics now (queue length, GPU util, pod restarts). Assigning eng-runtime to lead RCa.

maria: how do we prioritize? Sales says customer is threatening to pause traffic if SLA not restored.

sahil: this is critical. HelixHealth revenue-impacting. Their target p95 <= 350ms. Legal wants mitigation plan in 24h; exec escalation in 72h if not resolved.

lee (Eng-Platform): short-term mitigation we can implement immediately: route 30% of HelixHealth traffic off the quantized variant to hosted redwood-13b-v1 and scale up dedicated pool min nodes by 1 to reduce queueing. Proposed routing policy: 

```json
{ "match": { "customer_id": "helix" }, "route": [ { "model": "redwood-13b-v1", "pct": 30 }, { "model": "redwood-13b-v1-quant", "pct": 70 } ], "ttl": "24h" }
```

kai: I'll start runtime traces and a perf repro against a staging copy of their workload. If we see kernel fallback we may need to pin or revert the quant build. ETA for root cause: 6-8h. ETA for safe production patch: 24-48h.

maria: proposed acceptance/launch criteria for the fix: p95 <= 350ms under observed load; smoke checks across top 10 customers; canary + rollback in Console; customer sign-off on SLA restoration.

tess (Support): notified customer we'll provide a mitigation within 2h and an RCA/ETA in 8h. They're OK with staged routing as temporary measure.

sahil: add to product backlog as P1. If fix timeline exceeds 72h escalate to exec.

aj: infra metrics uploaded; queue latency spike aligns with kernel-fallback entries and increase in batch accumulation starting ~02:28 UTC: https://ci.redwood/metrics/helix-queue-2150123456 (redacted).

kai: starting perf repro and KV cache validation now. Will post first-pass traces within 2h.

deploy-bot: Canary routing change scheduled by lee at 2150124000 (approx in ~6 minutes).

maria: owners: kai (eng-runtime) for RCA & patch, lee (eng-platform) for routing mitigation, tess for customer comms, maria for product PRD + backlog. Targets: mitigation live in 2h, RCA/ETA in 8h. :thumbsup:

sahil: thanks. Ping oncall if escalates. @aj prep notes for postmortem.

kai: acknowedged. Will report trace summary and perf numbers in thread within 2h.
